summary: New Haven 'chirurgeon' lost on the Phantom Ship of 1646; formerly in John's tree, now probably not an ancestor.
bio: Francis Brewster 'of London, who came to New Haven in 1638 with the party of Eaton and Davenport' (Champlin 1915). A New Haven 'chirurgeon' (surgeon), presumably lost on Lamberton's 'Great Shippe', which sailed in January 1646 through a channel cut in the ice of the harbor; in 1648 it appeared as the famous 'Phantom Ship' in the sky over New Haven. His inventory is dated 30 Dec 1647. 'Born Bristol c.1599' appears on unsourced pages (speculative).
